ohtani.title: Oli Marmol recaps Cardinals' 8-6 win over Dodgers
ohtani.blurb: Oli Marmol talks the Cardinals rebounding after getting in a 3-0 deficit, Thomas Saggese's big game and more following the Cardinals' win vs. Dodgers

imanaga.title: Héctor Rodríguez hits a three-run homer in Reds' win
imanaga.blurb: Héctor Rodríguez hits a three-run homer along with three other Reds in their 7-5 win over the Cubs

suzuki.title: Gausman's dominance, PCA's home run lead Cubs' win
suzuki.blurb: Kevin Gausman strikes out nine over seven innings and Pete Crow-Armstrong hits a two-run home run to lead the Cubs to a 2-1 win over the Brewers

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Vlad Jr. and Cease power Blue Jays' shutout win
okamoto.blurb: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. crushes a three-run homer while Dylan Cease pitches six scoreless innings in the Blue Jays' 11-0 win vs. the Guardians

murakami.title: Altuve's homer, four-run 3rd spark Astros' 6-2 win
murakami.blurb: Jose Altuve's homer and a four-run 3rd inning spark the offense, plus Hunter Brown strikes out seven in the Astros' 6-2 win over the White Sox

matsui.title: Jose Trevino comes through late in Reds' 4-3 win
matsui.blurb: Jose Trevino hits a go-ahead single in the 8th and Nick Lodolo tosses six strong innings in the Reds' 4-3 win over the Padres
